summary: Full E2E test of Facets CRM AI MVP. Backend: 26/26 tests passing after fixing one ObjectId leak in POST /api/employees. Frontend: all critical flows verified — admin login, dashboard with 8 KPI cards, leads page (search/filters/views), pipeline (all 8 stages), call simulator (dial→connected→hangup→save), real Claude AI summary (returns sentiment/score/next_action), WhatsApp conversations (50 seeded) + send, tasks, employees, reports (funnel/pie/line/bar charts render), settings, notifications sheet, global search.

minor.issue: Returned MongoDB ObjectId in response causing 500 (FIXED by excluding _id from response dict)
Route registered AFTER app.include_router(api) on line 738 — FastAPI ignores it. Returns 404. Not critical (not used by frontend) but should be moved above include_router.

issues: Settings backdrop becomes very dark/dim while Notifications sheet is open — possible double overlay; minor.

action_items: (Optional) Move @api.get('/health') above app.include_router(api) so health endpoint is reachable.
(Optional) Add DialogContent description / aria-describedby — minor a11y warnings logged from Radix dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~740 lines — borderline; consider splitting routers into modules (leads.py, calls.py, etc.) once features grow.

create_employee originally returned the raw doc after insert_one(doc) which mutates doc to include _id — fixed by excluding _id. Apply the same pattern proactively in other write paths if added later.
Health route is unreachable because it is registered after include_router(). Move it up.
JWT secret is committed in /app/backend/.env — acceptable for demo, but rotate before production.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all flows verified manually via Playwright; the 2 reported script failures were selector mistakes in my own test (used input[name='name'] instead of [data-testid='new-lead-name'], and 'profile-menu-btn' instead of 'profile-menu-trigger') — the app's data-testids are correct.

test_credentials: admin@facetscrm.com / password123, sales@facetscrm.com / password123, manager@facetscrm.com / password123 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup (idempotent): 25 users, 100 leads, tasks, calls, WhatsApp messages, notifications. Verified by GET /api/leads returning 100 items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. The AI summary test calls real Claude (Emergent LLM key), takes 5-10s, may be flaky if quota issues — gives it 60s timeout. Frontend correct selectors: new-lead-{name|company|phone|email|website|city|state|industry}, profile-menu-trigger, logout-btn, login-submit-button.
rca of the issue: ObjectId leak in POST /api/employees: insert_one() mutates the inserted document to add MongoDB-assigned _id; the response comprehension filtered only 'password_hash'. Fix: also exclude '_id'. Reproduction: POST /api/employees as admin → 500 'ObjectId not iterable'. Verified fixed (test_create_employee_admin now passes).
